name: Animal Empathy (Gestalt)
body:
You can alter the attitudes of animals.

Prerequisite: Handle Animal 3 ranks, Cha 13

Benefit: You can use Handle Animal to improve the attitude of an animal. This ability functions just like a druid’s Wild Empathy ability, except you roll a Handle Animal check to influence the attitude of the animal, you take a -2 penalty to your check, and you cannot use this ability to attempt to influence a magical beast.
